arxiv-1809-04022.title: Can LSTM Learn to Capture Agreement? The Case of Basque
arxiv-1809-04022.creator: Shauli Ravfogel, Francis M. Tyers, Yoav Goldberg
arxiv-1809-04022.description: Abstract Sequential neural networks models are powerful tools in a variety of Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. The sequential nature of these models raises the questions: to what extent can these models implicitly learn hierarchical structures typical to human language, and what kind of grammatical phenomena can they acquire?

arxiv-2101-01195.title: The rapid transition from star-formation to AGN dominated rest-frame UV light at 𝐳 ≃ 𝟒 \mathbf{z\simeq 4} 2020 The rapid transition from star-formation to AGN dominated rest-frame UV light at 𝐳 ≃ 𝟒 \mathbf{z\simeq 4} – 11
arxiv-2101-01195.creator: R. A. A. Bowler, N. J. Adams, M. J. Jarvis B. Häußler
arxiv-2101-01195.description: Abstract With the advent of deep optical-to-near-infrared extragalactic imaging on the degree scale, samples of high-redshift sources are being selected that contain both bright star-forming (SF) galaxies and faint active galactic nuclei (AGN). In this study we investigate the transition between SF and AGN-dominated systems at z ≃ 4 z\simeq 4 in the rest-frame UV.

arxiv-2105-05887.title: Black or White but Never Neutral: How Readers Perceive Identity from Yellow or Skin-toned Emoji Journal: PACMHCI Volume: 5 CSCW2 350 10 Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.1145/3476091 CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in HCI CCS: Applied computing Sociology
arxiv-2105-05887.creator: Alexander Robertson, Walid Magdy, Sharon Goldwater
arxiv-2105-05887.description: Abstract . Research in sociology and linguistics shows that people use language not only to express their own identity but to understand the identity of others. Recent work established a connection between expression of identity and emoji usage on social media, through use of emoji skin tone modifiers.

arxiv-2109-04004.title: OpenClinicalAI: enabling AI to diagnose diseases in real-world clinical settings
arxiv-2109-04004.creator: Yunyou Huang, Nana Wang, Suqin Tang, Li Ma, Tianshu Hao, Zihan Jiang, Fan Zhang, Guoxin Kang, Xiuxia Miao, Xianglong Guan, Ruchang Zhang, Zhifei Zhang, Jianfeng Zhan, for the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
arxiv-2109-04004.description: Abstract This paper quantitatively reveals the state-of-the-art and state-of-the-practice AI systems only achieve acceptable performance on the stringent conditions that all categories of subjects are known, which we call closed clinical settings, but fail to work in real-world clinical settings.

arxiv-2201-02306.title: Reconstructing Rayleigh-Bénard flows out of temperature-only measurements using nudging
arxiv-2201-02306.creator: Lokahith Agasthya, Patricio Clark Di Leoni, Luca Biferale
arxiv-2201-02306.description: Abstract Nudging is a data assimilation technique that has proved to be capable of reconstructing several highly turbulent flows from a set of partial spatiotemporal measurements. In this study we apply the nudging protocol on the temperature field in a Rayleigh-Bénard Convection system at varying levels of turbulence.

arxiv-2312-09423.title: Decoding EEG–based Workload Levels Using Spatio–temporal Features Under Flight Environment Thanks: This research was supported by the Challengeable Future Defense Technology Research and Development Program (912911601) of Agency for Defense Development in 2020 and was partly supported by the Institu
arxiv-2312-09423.creator: Dae-Hyeok Lee, Si-Hyun Kim, Sung-Jin Kim, Seong-Whan Lee
arxiv-2312-09423.description: Abstract The detection of pilots’ mental states is important due to the potential for their abnormal mental states to result in catastrophic accidents. This study introduces the feasibility of employing deep learning techniques to classify different workload levels, specifically normal state, low workload, and high workload.

arxiv-2403-03796.title: Complete NLO corrections to top-quark pair production with isolated photons
arxiv-2403-03796.creator: Daniel Stremmer, and Malgorzata Worek
arxiv-2403-03796.description: Abstract We compute for the first time the so-called complete NLO corrections to top-quark pair production with one and two isolated photons in the di-lepton top-quark decay channel. The Narrow Width Approximation is used for the modeling of unstable top quarks and W W bosons.

arxiv-2405-08539.title: SecScore : Enhancing the CVSS Threat Metric Group with Empirical Evidences
arxiv-2405-08539.creator: Miguel Santana, Vinicius V. Cogo, Alan Oliveira de Sá
arxiv-2405-08539.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Miguel Santana, Vinicius V. Cogo, Alan Oliveira de Sá. Background: Timely prioritising and remediating vulnerabilities are paramount in the dynamic cybersecurity field, and one of the most widely used vulnerability scoring systems (CVSS) does not address the increasing likelihood of emerging an exploit code. Aims: We present SecScore , an innovative vulnerability severity score that enhances CVSS Threat metric group with statistical models from empirical evidences of real-world exploit codes.

arxiv-2410-09862.title: Conditioning 3D Diffusion Models with 2D Images: Towards Standardized OCT Volumes through En Face -Informed Super-Resolution
arxiv-2410-09862.creator: Coen de Vente, Mohammad Mohaiminul Islam, Philippe Valmaggia, Carel Hoyng, Adnan Tufail, Clara I. Sánchez on behalf of the MACUSTAR consortium
arxiv-2410-09862.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Coen de Vente, Mohammad Mohaiminul Islam, Philippe Valmaggia, Carel Hoyng, Adnan Tufail, Clara I. Sánchez on behalf of the MACUSTAR consortium. High anisotropy in volumetric medical images can lead to the inconsistent quantification of anatomical and pathological structures. Particularly in optical coherence tomography (OCT), slice spacing can substantially vary across and within datasets, studies, and clinical practices.

arxiv-2410-16332.title: Thermodynamic functions of the Fermi gas at arbitrary temperatures
arxiv-2410-16332.creator: Yu.M. Poluektov, A.A. Soroka
arxiv-2410-16332.description: Abstract Thermodynamic functions of the ideal Fermi gas at arbitrary temperatures are calculated using the standard Fermi-Stoner functions. The properties of the Fermi-Stoner functions are analyzed. The limiting cases of low-temperature and classical limits with taking into account quantum corrections and the special case of zero chemical potential are considered.

arxiv-2505-01663.title: Isentropic process of Reissner-Nordström black holes: a possible excess of the entropy bound via a non-perturbative channel
arxiv-2505-01663.creator: Robert B. Mann a,b,c and Dong-han Yeom a,d,e,f
arxiv-2505-01663.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Robert B. Mann a,b,c and Dong-han Yeom a,d,e,f. We study the implications of an isentropic processes applied to a Reissner-Nordström black hole. This process is possible if a black hole absorbs a particle with a specific ratio of energy and charge. We show that such an absorption process is not classically allowed, not only in Einstein gravity but also in several modified gravity theories, indicating that this prohibition is quite generic.

arxiv-2506-23549.title: CooT : Learning to Coordinate In-Context with Coordination Transformers
arxiv-2506-23549.creator: Huai-Chih Wang, Hsiang-Chun Chuang, Hsi-Chun Cheng, Dai-Jie Wu, Shao-Hua Sun
arxiv-2506-23549.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Huai-Chih Wang, Hsiang-Chun Chuang, Hsi-Chun Cheng, Dai-Jie Wu, Shao-Hua Sun. Effective coordination among artificial agents in dynamic and uncertain environments remains a significant challenge in multi-agent systems. Existing approaches, such as self-play and population-based methods, either generalize poorly to unseen partners or require impractically extensive training. To overcome these limitations, we propose Coordination Transformers ( CooT ), a novel in-context coordination framework that uses recent interaction histories to rapidly adapt to unseen partners.

arxiv-2508-12521.title: A basis of the alternating diagonal coinvariants
arxiv-2508-12521.creator: Yuhan Jiang
arxiv-2508-12521.description: Abstract . We give an explicit basis for the alternating part of the diagonal coinvariant ring in terms of bivariate Vandermonde determinants, answering a question of Stump. 1. Introduction The symmetric group S_{n} acts diagonally on the polynomial ring \mathbb{C}[\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}]:=\mathbb{C}[x_{1},y_{1},\dots,x_{n},y_{n}].

arxiv-2508-17870.title: General Learning of the Electric Response of Inorganic Materials
arxiv-2508-17870.creator: Bradley A. A. Martin, Keith T. Butler, Venkat Kapil, Alex M. Ganose
arxiv-2508-17870.description: Abstract We present MACE-Field , a field-aware O ⁡ ( 3 ) O(3) -equivariant interatomic potential that provides a compact, derivative-consistent route to dielectric properties (such as polarisation 𝐏 \mathbf{P} , Born effective charges Z ∗ Z^{*} and polarisability 𝜶 \bm{\alpha} ) and finite-field simulations across chemistry for inorganic solids.

arxiv-2512-04336.title: LHC Shines on Positivity
arxiv-2512-04336.creator: Zhen Liu, Kun-Feng Lyu, Tong Arthur Wu
arxiv-2512-04336.description: Abstract We show that hadron colliders have an excellent reach for positivity tests on a class of diphoton operators. Due to the helicity selection rules, the relevant dimension-6 operators either do not contribute or are highly constrained by other experimental observables.

arxiv-2601-21990.title: Batched First-Order Methods for Parallel LP Solving in MIP
arxiv-2601-21990.creator: Nicolas Blin, Stefano Gualandi, Christopher Maes, Andrea Lodi, Bartolomeo Stellato
arxiv-2601-21990.description: Abstract We present a batched first-order method for solving multiple linear programs in parallel on GPUs. Our approach extends the primal-dual hybrid gradient algorithm to efficiently solve batches of related linear programming problems that arise in mixed-integer programming techniques such as strong branching and bound tightening.

arxiv-2602-17220.title: Interfacial orbital transmission, conversion, and mechanical torque in metals
arxiv-2602-17220.creator: Chi Sun, Dongwook Go, Yuriy Mokrousov, Jacob Linder, Aurélien Manchon
arxiv-2602-17220.description: Abstract Interfacial orbital transport remains far less understood than its bulk counterpart despite its central role in orbitronic experiments. Here, we theoretically investigate the transmission and conversion of orbital angular momentum across a metallic interface using a model Hamiltonian incorporating crystal-field effects.

We set out to capture a representative cross-sectional sample of published SRs and examine them in terms of a broad range of epidemiological, descriptive, and reporting characte

pmc-11455890.title: Comparison of a Scheimpflug imaging with other screening indices in diagnosing keratoconus and keratoconus suspect
pmc-11455890.creator: Yan Huo, Ruisi Xie, Xuan Chen, Shuangcheng Li, Haohan Zou, Yutong Liu, Yan Wang
pmc-11455890.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Keratoconus (KC) is an irreversible blinding eye disease; therefore, early screening of KC suspects (KCS) is crucial for protecting patients’ quality of life. Scheimpflug imaging is a commonly used screening device in clinical practice. We aimed to evaluate the diagnostic ability of a Scheimpflug imaging device (Scansys) for KC and KCS and compared it with other Scheimpflug-based devices (Pentacam and Corvis ST). This prospective case-control study included 107 normal eyes, 72 KCS, and 57 KC.

pmc-11470877.title: Regulation of Cx36 trafficking through the early secretory pathway by COPII cargo receptors and Grasp55
pmc-11470877.creator: Stephan Tetenborg, Fatemeh Ariakia, Elizabeth Martinez-Soler, Eyad Shihabeddin, Ignacio Cebrian Lazart, Adam C Miller, John O’Brien
pmc-11470877.description: Gap junctions formed by the major neuronal connexin Cx36 function as electrical synapses in the nervous system and provide unique functions such as synchronizing neuron activities or supporting network oscillations. Although the physiological significance of electrical synapses for neuronal networks is well established, little is known about the pathways that regulate the transport of its main component: Cx36.

pmc-11558933.title: Propofol-induced transient arginine vasopressin deficiency
pmc-11558933.creator: Michael D Luppino, Huyen Nguyen, Matilda Smale, Rebecca Madigan, Morton G Burt, Mahesh M Umapathysivam
pmc-11558933.description: SummaryWe describe and characterise the case of a 26-year-old female undergoing surgery for a right-sided sinonasal alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma who developed profound, transient arginine vasopressin deficiency (AVP-D, formerly central diabetes insipidus (DI)) associated with anaesthesia. In this case report, we characterise the development of AVP-D with serial copeptin and paired urine and serum osmolality measurements.

pmc-11692048.title: EVALUATION OF A LATINO BRAIN HEALTH FAIR FOR ALZHEIMER’S DISEASE EDUCATION AND RESEARCH RECRUITMENT
pmc-11692048.creator: Theresa Kehne, Janet Rojina, Linda Ko, Sonia Bishop, Kelley Pascoe, Kimiko Domoto-Reilly, Israel Anaya-Carmona, Karen Torres
pmc-11692048.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Hispanic/Latino individuals are at higher risk of developing Alzheimer’s disease (AD) than non-Hispanic White individuals, yet risk factors in the Hispanic/Latino community are not well understood due to barriers impacting research participation. This study, in partnership with a community advisory board, developed and evaluated a novel “Brain Health Fair” (BHF) intervention for increasing AD knowledge and willingness to participate in AD research among Hispanic/Latino individuals.

pmc-12581486.title: Radiology knowledge and career interest among medical students in Egypt, Libya, and Yemen: a multicenter cross-sectional study
pmc-12581486.creator: Muataz Kashbour, Omar Al Dabssi, Mahmoud Ahmed Yahia Abdelaziz, Sarah Amro, Ruaa Mustafa Qafesha, Radfan Yahya Al-Abdi, Mohamed Abdelaal Nasser, Menna Elbadry, Mariam Balti, Ahmed H Elmasry, Moad Ali Gassim Shetwan, Aiesha Imbarek Hassan Ibrahim
pmc-12581486.description: BackgroundRadiology plays a crucial role in diagnosing and managing numerous diseases, yet it remains underrepresented in many medical school curricula. This is the first multicenter study to evaluate the knowledge and attitudes of Arab medical students towards radiology, aiming to identify educational disparities and their potential causes.MethodsThis cross-sectional study was conducted across three Arab countries: Egypt, Libya, and Yemen.

pmc-12735731.title: Lived Experience of Volunteers During Humanitarian Surgical Missions: A Qualitative Study Protocol
pmc-12735731.creator: Simone Amato, Vincenza Giordano, Alessio Lo Cascio, Daniele Napolitano, Francesco Gravante, Noemi Giannetta, Mauro Parozzi, Mattia Bozzetti, Paola Arcadi, Mariachiara Figura, Richard Gray
pmc-12735731.description: Background: Humanitarian surgical missions play a critical role in addressing health disparities, particularly in low-resource settings where conditions such as cleft lip and palate (CL/P) are prevalent. The success of these missions relies heavily on the commitment of volunteers, including healthcare professionals and logistical personnel.

pmc-12831262.title: Orthopedic manifestations of acquired hemophilia: a case report on uncontrolled bleeding and progressive swelling post-phlebotomy- should fasciotomy be considered?
pmc-12831262.creator: Parham Talebian, Mohammad Soleimani, Mahsa Mottahedi, Elham Nazar, Parmida Shahbazi
pmc-12831262.description: BackgroundAcquired hemophilia A (AHA) is a rare bleeding disorder caused by autoantibodies against clotting factors, often resulting in spontaneous bleeding or bleeding after minor trauma, potentially leading to Acute Compartment Syndrome (ACS). Diagnosing and managing AHA-induced ACS is challenging due to its rarity and the risks associated with fasciotomy in bleeding disorders.

pmc-13113534.title: Effect of Dietary Calcium Nitrate Addition on Methane Emission, Nitrogen Excretion, and Ruminal Fermentation Parameters and Microbiota in Liuyang Black Goats
pmc-13113534.creator: Mingming Li, Ting Liu, Chen Zheng, Xuan Nan, Jun Wang, Baicong Chen, Hanfang Zeng
pmc-13113534.description: Simple SummaryThis study explored the effects of incorporating calcium nitrate into the diets of Liuyang black goats on methane emissions and their digestive processes. Results revealed that the addition of calcium nitrate significantly reduced both methane and carbon dioxide emissions from these goats.

pmc-13427699.title: Color stability of CAD/CAM and additively manufactured resin materials: influence of surface treatment and layer thickness - an in vitro study
pmc-13427699.creator: Tina Willmen, Merle Lankenau, Meike Stiesch, Philipp-Cornelius Pott
pmc-13427699.description: The increasing establishment of digital workflows in dentistry has brought both subtractive CAD/CAM processes and additive manufacturing techniques for fixed dental restorations into focus. This in vitro study aimed to compare the color stability of a CAD/CAM nanohybrid composite with a ceramic-filled, additively manufactured resin and to investigate how surface treatment and layer thickness influence this stability.

uslaw-usc-t12-s5603.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s5603.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 53 (Wall Street Reform And Consumer Protection); Subchapter V (Bureau Of Consumer Financial Protection); Part G (Regulatory Improvements). uslaw-usc-t42-s1778.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 13A (Child Nutrition). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. uslaw-usc-t46-s10509.title: 46 U.S.C. § 10509 — Penalty for failing to begin voyage
uslaw-usc-t46-s10509.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s10509.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Part G (Merchant Seamen Protection And Relief); Chapter 105 (Coastwise Voyages). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) A seaman who fails to be on board at the time contained in the agreement required by section 10502 of this title, without having given 24 hours’ notice of inability to do so, shall forfeit, for each hour’s lateness.
